title: agropyron caninum var. tenerum
intro: Agropyron caninum var. tenerum, commonly known as Blue Wild Rye, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Blue Wild Rye include wound healing, anti-aging, and immune system modulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
